# Oracle response reliability remediation — reviewed plan

## Goal, authority and exclusions
Owner authorizes plan, Advisor adversarial review, TODO creation/update, then implementation and BenchBox PR closeout. Reviewer receives a JSON response TEMPLATE TO POPULATE, not an example. Findings: duplicate JSON keys can erase defects; a broad SWF guard would break follow-up scoping; unfilled placeholders can look like valid paths; redaction must run before AND after text transformations, before truncation. ## Evidence already obtained and limitations
Current code reproduced rejecting a complete SWF missing summary/incomplete_reason. Corpus check in the integrator worktree observed 302 valid stored verdicts, 118 with retained original plans: 57 SHIP, 58 SWF, 3 DO_NOT_SHIP. Four invalid diagnostics parse as full JSON, but only one remains structurally invalid: PR3237 run39662535698. These numbers describe the available corpus, not a current production success rate. This proves source summaries harm review and queries can expose almost nothing. It does not prove CI pinned linux build/config parity. OMP_AGENT_CONFIG secret is unavailable locally; after-merge CI observation is required.

## Common invariants
1. Normalization only at reviewer ingress; stored artifacts remain strictly validated, never silently repaired.
2. No finding, severity/location, status/decision, prior status/evidence is dropped/invented. Unknown top-level keys, missing decision fields, extra JSON/prose, duplicate keys and unsafe placeholders fail closed.
3. DO_NOT_SHIP blocks; any counted/carried finding blocks. Existing out-of-scope-only SWF can still yield SHIP with not-counted disclosure.
4. One extra same-reviewer attempt after eligible absence; never resample a valid verdict. Keep run slot cap and quota/auth/timeout exclusions.
5. Evidence remains partial-read exposure, not whole-file or semantic proof. Directory/multi-path grep match metadata does not credit files.
6. Raw event streams and live credentials are not uploaded. Exact redaction is known-value hygiene, not a defense against arbitrary obfuscation or a secret-read sandbox.

## A. Ingress normalization and fail-closed parsing — Main owner
Files: verdict.py, protocol.py, attempts.py, runner.py ingress seam, relevant tests, Decisions docs/decision record.
- Reject duplicate JSON object keys at every depth during ingress JSON decoding, including response envelopes, before dictionaries collapse. Do not extract the first JSON object from prose/multiple objects.
- Closed normalizations: drop only observed extra finding metadata (line_note,end_line_note,detail_extra); prior metadata (severity,file,line,end_line,title,detail); dictionary priors -> list with valid normalized keys, object values, embedded ID agreeing after one existing '#' removal, missing ID copied from key; default missing incomplete_reason to empty and missing summary to empty ONLY when decision is not DO_NOT_SHIP. No case folding or arbitrary extras.
- Existing validate stays strict. Named missing/extra key errors use safe bounded redaction, not raw model key fragments.
- Define JSON template placeholder constants once in verdict.py. Ingress rejects exact leftover placeholder strings recursively in any field; enum placeholders outside enums and line0 cannot pass. Template builder in D imports these constants.
- Shared `protocol.contradiction(verdict, plan)` guard: only complete SWF with len(defects)==0 AND listed==0 AND no carried/open prior after citation marking/forced rejudge is invalid. Call from runner and attempts._attempt; no exception from judge. Out-of-scope-only nonempty SWF preserves current scoping. Replay must also reject contradictory stored verdicts.
- Record rewrite labels and bounded safe shape fingerprint in diagnostic; supplement, do not replace, existing 2000char redacted invalid tail. Keys only [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,39}, no known secrets; unsafe names become count. Types only, depth<=3, <=20keys/object, lists as counts, total<=512bytes.
Acceptance: actual PR3237 body becomes SWF with D6 still not_fixed (never approval). Duplicate keys, normalized ID collision, bad enum/type, unknown top-level, missing finding fields, DNS missing summary, leftover placeholder and actual empty SWF invalid. Out-of-scope-only SWF remains scoped SHIP. Strict artifact replay rejects unnormalized malformed shapes and contradictory SWF. All 302 stored verdict judgements preserved where original plan available; mutation checks of allowed rewrites preserve outcomes. Full stored corpus limitation documented.
